title.narrative: Programme to Finance Safety Retrofits and Environmental upgrades in the Bangladeshi Ready-Made Garment (RMG) Sector

description.narrative: The Action aims at 1. Facilitating the financing of RMG factories in Bangladesh so that they can perform i) safety investments; ii) Environmental and social investments. 2. Providing assistance to RMG factories to design their investments projects and to mitigate the envrionmental and social impacts of their business activity.

title.narrative: Number of factories with mitigated environmental impact

description.narrative: It is not mandatory for factories to undertake environmentallyrelated investments under the action.Yet, given the incentive offered by AIFbased performance grant, it is expected that 25% of the 150ACA/2016/378599 6 factories targeted by the action will make green investments. In this respect, a midterm committee review is planned to ensure that AIF grant will benefit to a minimum number of green investments.

title.narrative: Number of (a) jobs supported/sustained by the EU

description.narrative: SDG 8 Decent Work and Economic GrowthFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: This figure corresponds to the number of workers employed in the 150 factories targeted by the action for 1300 workers per factory on average according to the Accord.These jobs will not only be sustained due to the continuation of the commercial relationship between RMG factories and western retailers but the working conditions of workers will be also made less hazardous.Among the 195000 workers who could benefit from the action around 80 are women.

Quality control comment August 2023 The value has been modified from 46795 jobs to 0. SoV received is the progress report n.5 from december 2022. Value in page 20. It seems that the cumulative value is 84210 instead of 46795 jobs. The latter is the increase it seems in the last year of implementation but the indicator measures number of jobs with improved working conditions and not number of jobs created. Either the narrative of the report or in the comments field in OPSYS there is not sufficient information to determine if there was any job creation involved and they are full time equivalent jobs as the methodology note determines. Therefore the value has been modified from 46795 jobs to 0.
